description_en: Removes the metadata of a file from a dataset
description_zh: 从数据集内删除文件的元信息
kebab_example: aliyun imm delete-file-meta --project-name test-project --dataset-name test-datset --uri oss://test-bucket/test-object --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteFileMeta

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the dataset. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称，获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.help_en:
The URI of the file in OSS.

Specify the value in the oss://${Bucket}/${Object} format. `${Bucket}` specifies the name of the OSS bucket that resides in the same region as the current project. `${Object}` specifies the path of the object with the extension included.

The URI of the file in Photo and Drive Service must be in the pds://domains/${domain}/drives/${drive}/files/${file}/revisions/${revision} format
parameters.name: uri
